U.K. Announces £10 Billion Support Package for Ukraine, Its Largest to Date

Britain has announced its largest ever support package for Ukraine, worth £10 billion, including £7 billion in economic support over three years and a £3 billion increase in export finance capacity,

Lithuania to Introduce Universal Military Conscription for Men in 2032

Lithuania will introduce universal military conscription for eligible young men in 2032, President Gitanas Nausėda announced. 

The annual intake is expected to rise from more than 5,000 to around 7,500,
